step1_figure.circuit_type: CMOS Differential Amplifier with Current Mirror Load and Cascode Tail Current Source
step1_figure.description: An NMOS input differential pair (M1, M2) loaded by a PMOS current mirror (M3, M4) and biased by a cascode tail current source (M6t, M6b) driven by a bias generation circuit (SUB_1 / Fig. 20.47). VI1 provides a 1 mV AC signal at 10 MHz riding on a 500 mV DC level, with VI2 held at 500 mV DC.

differential_voltage_gain.description: Small-signal differential voltage gain Ad = vout / (vi1 - vi2)

equation.explanation: The small-signal gain is the product of input transistor transconductance gm and the parallel combination of output resistances of M2 (NMOS) and M4 (PMOS).
equation.assumptions: All transistors operate in saturation; symmetric small-signal half-circuits.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming Iss = 20 uA (10 uA per branch), un*Cox = 270 uA/V^2, (W/L)n = 10u/0.5u = 20: gm = sqrt(2 * un*Cox * (W/L) * ID) = sqrt(2 * 270u * 20 * 10u) = 328 uA/V. Output resistance ro = 1 / (lambda * ID) = 1 / (0.1 * 10u) = 1 MOhm. rout = ro2 || ro4 = 500 kOhm. Ad = 328 uA/V * 500 kOhm = 164 V/V ≈ 44.3 dB. For shorter channels or higher Vov, typical gain is 24 to 40 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends on channel length and biasing; typical short/medium-channel devices in Sky130 yield an open-loop single-stage gain of 25-35 dB.

dc_output_voltage.description: Quiescent DC operating voltage at the output node

equation.explanation: When inputs are balanced, the output node quiescent voltage settles at VDD - VSG of the PMOS mirror load.
equation.assumptions: Symmetric differential pair and current mirror matching.

sky130_expected.calculation: VDD = 1.8 V. For PMOS M3 with ID = 10 uA, |Vthp| = 0.42 V, up*Cox = 50 uA/V^2, (W/L)p = 20u/0.5u = 40: Vovp = sqrt(2 * 10u / (50u * 40)) = 0.10 V. VSG3 = |Vthp| + Vovp = 0.42 + 0.10 = 0.52 V. Vout_DC = 1.8 - 0.52 = 1.28 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by PMOS threshold and overdrive voltage below the 1.8 V rail.

max_output_voltage.description: Maximum output voltage before M4 enters triode

equation.explanation: The output can swing towards VDD until the PMOS load transistor M4 enters the triode region.

sky130_expected.calculation: VDD = 1.8 V, VSD,sat ≈ 0.15 V. VOUTMAX = 1.8 - 0.15 = 1.65 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: One overdrive drop below the supply rail VDD = 1.8 V.

min_output_voltage.description: Minimum output voltage before M2 enters triode

equation.explanation: The drain of M2 can swing down until VDS2 drops below VGS2 - VTHN, meaning VD2 reaches VG2 - VTHN.
equation.assumptions: M2 remains in saturation; VI2 = 0.5 V DC.

sky130_expected.calculation: VI2 = 0.5 V, VTHN ≈ 0.42 V (without body effect) or ~0.55 V (with body effect). VOUTMIN = 0.5 - 0.42 = 0.08 V. Practically limited by the tail node voltage plus VDS,sat2 ≈ 0.2 V + 0.15 V = 0.35 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Output is constrained either by M2 entering triode or the cascode current sink headroom.

max_common_mode_input_voltage.description: Maximum common-mode input voltage maintaining M1/M2 in saturation

equation.explanation: Maximum common-mode input voltage before the NMOS input transistors M1/M2 enter the triode region.
equation.assumptions: Balanced input; PMOS drain at VDD - VSG.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Can exceed the drain voltage of the input devices by one NMOS threshold voltage.

min_common_mode_input_voltage.description: Minimum common-mode input voltage maintaining current source in saturation

equation.explanation: Minimum gate potential required to turn on M1/M2 while keeping the cascode tail current source saturated.
equation.assumptions: Cascode tail current sink requires 2 * VDS,sat across it.

sky130_expected.calculation: VGS1,2 = VTHN + Vovn ≈ 0.42 + 0.12 = 0.54 V. Cascode tail drop = 2 * VDS,sat ≈ 2 * 0.15 = 0.30 V. VCMMIN = 0.54 + 0.30 = 0.84 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Requires gate-to-source drop of diff pair plus compliance voltage of cascode tail.

bandwidth_3db.description: 3-dB cutoff frequency with 1 pF load capacitance

equation.explanation: Pole frequency determined by the high-impedance output node resistance and load capacitance.
equation.assumptions: Dominant pole at the output node driving CL = 1 pF.

sky130_expected.calculation: rout = ro2 || ro4 ≈ 500 kOhm, CL = 1 pF: f3dB = 1 / (2 * pi * 500e3 * 1e-12) ≈ 318 kHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by the large output impedance of 300k - 1M ohm and 1 pF load.

quiescent_current.description: Total quiescent supply current consumed by the amplifier and bias network

equation.explanation: Total current drawn from the VDD power supply.
equation.assumptions: Inputs at nominal DC bias (500 mV).

sky130_expected.calculation: Diff pair conducts Iss ≈ 20 uA. The bias block SUB_1 draws approximately 40 to 80 uA across its mirror branches. Total IDD ≈ 60 to 100 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct sum of tail current and multi-branch cascode reference circuits.

step3_testbench.description: Ngspice testbench measuring DC operating point, small-signal differential AC gain, 3-dB bandwidth with 1 pF load, transient swing, and common-mode input DC sweep.
